scope: Native engine/input startup, discovery and game setup connect to naturally created manager and worker. Worker event 18 receives valid synthetic descriptor and three command-11 row responses, resumes through manager and reports type 15, clearing its event. Full retail RAM/CPU/FPU/special-register comparisons and independent copied row data/status/event checks. Caller supplies channel only; request arguments derived by worker. Event and request records populated by recovered setters with caller-supplied channel/event inputs. Readiness and device/hardware responses remain fixtures; not complete host device or full game.
